record.dic_text:
4639 skia {skee'-ah}

顯然是原形字; TDNT - 7:394,1044; 陰性名詞

欽定本- shadow 7; 7

1) 因遮斷光線而造成的陰影 
2) 影子
3) (實質物體的代表) 影象

   1b) an image cast by an object and representing the form of that object
   1c) a sketch, outline, adumbration
